reranked_evidence.title: South India leads India's nursing workforce as national ratio remains below WHO benchmark - The South First
reranked_evidence.snippet: # South India leads India’s nursing workforce as national ratio remains below WHO benchmark. > ***Synopsis:** Parliamentary data reveal a stark regional divide in India’s nursing workforce, with Kerala, Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh and Tamil Nadu accounting for nearly half of the country’s registered hospital nurses. South India has emerged as the country’s nursing powerhouse, with Kerala, Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh and Tamil Nadu accounting for nearly half of India’s registered hospital nursing workforce and recording some of the country’s highest nurse-population ratios, according to data tabled in Parliament. A written reply by Union Health Minister JP Nadda in the Rajya Sabha on 21 July states that India had 46.02 lakh registered nursing personnel as of 31 December 2025, translating to a nurse-population ratio of 2.60 per 1,000 people. “As per the Indian Nursing Council (INC) records, there are 46.02 lakh nursing personnel registered in the country as on 31st December, 2025, giving a nurse to population ratio of 2.60 nurses per 1000 population,” Nadda said in response to a starred question.

reranked_evidence.title: US measles cases hit 2,318 in 2026, surpassing last year's total: CDC - ABC News - Breaking News, Latest News and Videos
reranked_evidence.snippet: # US measles cases hit 2,318 in 2026, surpassing last year's total: CDC. This marks the highest number of cases recorded since 1991. The number of confirmed measles cases in the U.S. so far this year has hit 2,318, surpassing the total reported for all last year, according to data updated Friday from the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention. Previously, last year's total of 2,289 was the highest number of recorded measles cases in more than 30 years, CDC data shows. Sixteen of this year's total have been among international visitors to the U.S., according to the CDC. The majority of measles cases in 2026 have been confirmed among children and teenagers aged 19 and younger, according to the CDC. Meanwhile, 3% of cases are among those who have received just one dose of the measles, mumps, rubella (MMR) vaccine and 4% of cases are among those who received the recommended two doses, according to the CDC.

reranked_evidence.snippet: # Zero Tolerance Against Terrorism Is Not Merely Statement For India, But A Line Of Action: Rajnath. ### Sriharikota: Country’s First Pvt Orbital Rocket Vikram-1 Lifts Off. New Delhi : Backed by a major boost in indigenous defence production, India is rapidly emerging as a credible global security partner, expanding its strategic footprint from the Indian Ocean to the Indo-Pacific, Defence Minister Rajnath Singh said on Saturday. In an address at an event, Singh, sending a firm message to Pakistan, said New Delhi has clearly articulated its perspective on terrorism before the entire world and added that “zero tolerance against terrorism is not merely a statement for us, but a Line of Action”. The defence minister also highlighted India’s success in indigenous defence manufacturing. Defence products made in India are being exported to nearly 100 countries and the total volume of the country’s defence production has reached a record level of nearly Rs 1.78 lakh crore annually, he said. Singh said the success of Operation Sindoor is a testament to the trust in India’s industries.
